summary.text: Lilian Jiménez has represented the 4th District in the Illinois House of Representatives since December 2022.

paragraphs.text: She is an attorney who holds a bachelor's degree in political science and Latin American and Latino studies and a law degree from DePaul University.

She was previously chief of staff to Jesus "Chuy" Garcia at the Cook County Board of Commissioners, director of the Fair Labor Standards Division of the Illinois Department of Labor, and an administrator at the Illinois Department of Human Services.
She lives in West Humboldt Park.
